definitions.explanation: A class of biological molecules — DNA and RNA — that carry genetic information in all living organisms. Essential to the fields of genetics, molecular biology, and biotechnology.

examples.japanese: {核酸|かくさん}にはDNAとRNAがある。
examples.english: There are two types of nucleic acid: DNA and RNA.

examples.japanese: {核酸|かくさん}は{遺伝|いでん}{情報|じょうほう}を{担|にな}う{重要|じゅうよう}な{物質|ぶっしつ}だ。
examples.english: Nucleic acids are important substances that carry genetic information.

examples.japanese: ウイルスの{核酸|かくさん}を{検出|けんしゅつ}するPCR{検査|けんさ}は、{感染症|かんせんしょう}の{診断|しんだん}に{広|ひろ}く{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: PCR testing, which detects viral nucleic acids, is widely used for diagnosing infectious diseases.

notes:
Composed of {核|かく} (nucleus, core) and {酸|さん} (acid). So named because nucleic acids were first isolated from cell nuclei. The term became widely known to the general public through PCR testing during the COVID-19 pandemic, where "nucleic acid testing" ({核酸|かくさん}{検査|けんさ}) became a household phrase in Japan.

Note: the homophone {拡散|かくさん} (spread, diffusion) is a completely different word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {核酸|かくさん}{検査|けんさ}: nucleic acid test (PCR test)
- {核酸|かくさん}の{構造|こうぞう}: structure of nucleic acids
- {核酸|かくさん}{医薬品|いやくひん}: nucleic acid therapeutics
- {核酸|かくさん}を{抽出|ちゅうしゅつ}する: to extract nucleic acids

RELATED WORDS:
- DNA (ディーエヌエー): deoxyribonucleic acid — one of the two types of nucleic acid
- RNA (アールエヌエー): ribonucleic acid — the other type of nucleic acid
- {遺伝子|いでんし}: gene — a functional unit of nucleic acid
- {塩基|えんき}: base (chemistry) — the building blocks of nucleic acid sequences
